components.css: .ds-quick-sheet{font-family:var(--font,Heebo,system-ui,sans-serif);max-width:860px;background:var(--surface,#f2f6f4);color:var(--ink,#35204f);border:1px solid var(--line,#687a74);border-radius:12px;padding:28px}.ds-quick-sheet h2{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,29px);line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 18px}.ds-quick-sheet p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.8}.ds-quick-sheet summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:46px;max-width:260px;padding:0 24px;border:1px solid var(--action,#634086);border-radius:7px;background:var(--action,#634086);color:var(--action-ink,#fffaf2);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.ds-quick-sheet summary:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}.ds-quick-sheet summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link,#633c87);outline-offset:4px}.ds-quick-sheet summary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-quick-answer{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#687a74);margin-top:22px;padding-top:22px}.ds-quick-answer strong{color:var(--ink-2,#4d355f)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-quick-sheet{padding:21px 18px}.ds-quick-sheet p{font-size:17px}}.ds-quick-history{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:22px 0;font-family:var(--font,Heebo,system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-quick-history button{min-height:44px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#35204f);border:1px solid var(--line,#687a74);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-quick-history button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--soft,#dfd9e8);color:var(--link,#633c87);border-color:var(--link,#633c87)}.ds-quick-history button:hover{border-color:var(--link,#633c87)}.ds-quick-history button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link,#633c87);outline-offset:4px}.ds-quick-history button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-quick-sheet .ds-quick-finished{color:var(--ok,#216a50);font-size:14px;margin:-6px 0 18px}

narrative.overview:
The production practice app (apps/web) uses Mineral light, selected from /color-preview and approved for production on 2026-10-29: cool gray-green grounds, plum reading text and purple actions. The optional dark theme retains the adaptive Ion system approved on 2026-10-01: violet midnight surfaces, lilac links and amber actions. Heavy Heebo headings lead into calm reading and working areas, clear dividers and restrained panels. The dimensional violet chip is the approved identity image.

The private founder task app (apps/tasks) retains its engineering working notebook / ledger system: sage surroundings, white surfaces, deep-green actions and compact Heebo text. Its original metaphor remains an implementation assumption for that app only. The task app is a separate scope, not an Ion light variant. Galleries and /site-preview remain references.
keyCharacteristics: Hebrew-first text with logical alignment and technical LTR content.
Mineral light by default with an optional persistent dark Ion preference.
Flat practice panels, fine dividers and labelled semantic states.
Separate task palette, compact navigation and soft card depth.

rules.name: The Theme Continuity Rule
rules.body: Apply Mineral light and dark Ion through root semantic variables, including portals, charts and editors; changing theme preserves mounted work.

rules.name: The Labelled State Rule
rules.body: Status colors accompany written labels; keep the status meaning available in text.

rules.name: The Direction-Aware Text Rule
rules.body: Use logical alignment for interface text and preserve explicit LTR treatment for code and email fields.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Ion working panels rely on borders and tonal separation; task cards retain their subtle interactive shadows.

dos: Do preserve readable Hebrew and English through logical alignment and explicit code direction.
Do pair semantic colors with written status labels.
Do retain visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep Ion and task tokens within their documented application scope.
Do preserve the approved chip asset and its embedded provenance.
donts: Don't use the code font for ordinary interface text.
Don't extend the approved landing grid onto reading sheets or code workspaces; retain native technical diagrams and the circuit editor's functional dot grid.
Don't reintroduce handwriting, a navy header or sticky-note decoration into the production practice site.
Don't promote gallery alternatives or dormant legacy selectors into production rules.
Don't remove written navigation labels on compact layouts.
